text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"This is...
a failed mission, I take it."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Come now, do not be so disheartened.
Things not going as planned is simply the nature of battle."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, it is your duty to devise a strategy
to overturn the tide of this battle.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Strategist, let me see your work with my own eyes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
